senses.gloss: (II)--son of वरान्गी and Divamjaya; married बृहती; father of चाक्षुष. Br. II. ३६. १०१; वा. ६२. ८७.

(III)--a son of Babhru;
1: Br. III. ७४. 7.
killed by यौवनाश्व in a battle which lasted for १४ months.
2: वा. ९९. 7-8.
(IV)--(also वैरी). Even though insignificant, not to be neglected. It was भूत that slew हिरण्यकशिपु, and a woman चण्डिका that killed निशुम्भ, शुम्भ and महिष. Br. IV. २१. ४३ and ५५.
(V)--a son of शिष्टि(i1) and सुच्छाया, wife बृहती; his son चाक्षुष. M. 4. ३९; Vi. I. १३. 2.
(I)--the son of सुवीर (सुधीर वि। प्।) and father of Bahuratha. भा. IX. २१. २९-30; Vi. IV. १९. ५५. [page३-082+ २६]

(II)--a son of विश्वजित्--last link of the line;
1: भा. IX. २२. ४९.
with him ends the बृहद्रथ line after ruling for १००० years;
2: Vi. IV. २३. १२.
his minister Munika murdered him and enthroned his own son Pradyota.
3: Ib. IV. २४. 1-2.
Ruled for thirty-five years.
4: Br. III. ७४. ११४.
(III)--a son of Acala, ruled for ५० years. M. २७१. २९.
(IV)--a son of वराङ्गी and Divamjaya. वा. ६२. ८७.
(V)--a son of मेधावि and father of Urva. Vi. IV. २१. १३.
(VI)--a son of शिष्टि and सुच्छाया. Vi. I. १३. 2.
